answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks by charging real, verifiable work for every identity and refusing to let that work be copied. A newcomer must enter the forge and shape something useful with its own hands; no purchase shortcuts the apprenticeship. Each attested contribution sends a ripple through the peer network, and reviewers can trace the whole wave back to its source, so a synthetic crowd of fresh keys has no history to show. Standing hardens like marble only under years of honest pressure, while a farm of hollow accounts stays soft. Influence must be grown, never minted.
